.]] Crimson Court Pack is a bundle of Blood Queen-themed items that included a transmog set and a mount which could have been purchased from the Battle.net Shop. The bundle was available from 9 October 2025 to 12 January 2026. The contents in this bundle will become standalone shop items once this bundle has ended.
Crimson Cabalists are venthyr located in Castle Nathria during the fight against Sire Denathrius.
Crescent Cove Crab is sold by Olafus in Founder's Point for .

Crimson Bloodfeathers are dragonhawks located in northern Eversong Woods. One is found on Sunstrider Isle hovering above the corpses of Arcane Manathirsters and Mana Thirsters or of Glistening Hawkstriders.
The Crimson Dragonhawk is a dragonhawk mount rewarded by Midnight Glyph Hunter, which requires finding all of the Skyriding Glyphs in Eversong Woods, Zul'Aman, Harandar, and the Voidstorm.
Crest of Unending Woe is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 150 Trader's Tender.

Crimson Bow Tie is a cosmetic item obtainable from the promotion with [https://poptopia.pringles.com/ Pringles] that started on 6 January 2026 and lasts to 7 May 2026, available only to residents of Europe.
Crimson Bloodwater is available from the Crimson Tide Treasure event through 23 April to 23 May 2026. It is exclusive to the Chinese region.

Crimson Blessing has a chance to drop from a Heavy Trunk or Bountiful Heavy Trunk, after reaching rank 1 of the Delver's Journey during Midnight Season 1. The buff lasts for 24 hours or until the next delve is completed.
Crested Verdant Leafmimic is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 500 Trader's Tender.
Crested Aqua Leafmimic is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 500 Trader's Tender.
Crested Ember Leafmimic is the September 2026 completion award for filling out the Traveler's Log at the Trading Post.
Crimson Dragonstone Shoulderguards are an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Dragonstone Shoulderguards.
Crimson Assassins are stoneborn that spawn at the Royal Cellars in Castle Nathria during A Reflection of Truth.

Critter Battler of Khaz Algar is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the pet trainers of Khaz Algar with a team of all level 25 Critter pets.
The Crimson Mudnose is a mole mount. At Renown level 19 with the Assembly of the Deeps, it can be purchased for 8,125 Resonance Crystals from Waxmonger Squick in Gundargaz in the Ringing Deeps.

Crimson Oldblood are proto-dragons located in Suffusion Camp: Cinderwind in the Ohn'ahran Plains and in Suffusion Camp: Frostburn in the Azure Span during Fyrakk Assaults.
Croakit is a frog located in a cave at Stillstone Pond in Hallowfall. While inside the cave, he cannot be attacked. Feeding him 10 will make him leave the cave and turn hostile.
Croaking Sandskipper are skippers found along the coast nearest to Boulder Springs on the Isle of Dorn.
Crimson Lunar Firewhacker is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 300 Trader's Tender.
Crimson Pack of Lunar Explosives is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 250 Trader's Tender.
Crimson Silk Scrap can be looted from the Crimson Thread on the northwestern end of Rak-Ahat in Azj-Kahet. It serves as a clue for obtaining the "Weaving Supplies".

Crimson Snapdragon Treat drops from the Bilge Rat pirates on the Siren Isle. After learning it, it becomes available for purchase from Zexel Fingersnap for . It changes the appearance of the Prismatic Snapdragon mount.
Crimson Lunar Lantern is available for purchase at the Trading Post for 250 Trader's Tender.
The Crimson Shreddertank is a mechano-tank mount rewarded by The War Within Keystone Master: Season Two, which requires reaching a Mythic+ Rating of 2000 during The War Within Season 2.
Crimson Knockers are woodpeckers found in tree branches in the Azure Span.
Critter Battler of Undermine is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the pet trainers of Undermine with a team of all level 25 Critter pets.
Crimson Mechasaur is a mechasaur companion sold by Ditty Fuzeboy in the Toys-For-Less for .
The Crocodilian is a crocolisk located at Hovel Hill in the Undermine.
The Crocodilian's Head drops from the Crocodilian at Hovel Hill in the Undermine. It must be sent to Bruxie Slyhook in G.E.T.A. The Crocodilian.
Crispy Nerubian is a dead nerubian located in Earthcrawl Mines.

Critter Battler of Kalimdor is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating a variety of trainers in Kalimdor with a team of all level 25 Critter pets.
Critter Battler of Northrend is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating a variety of trainers in Northrend with a team of all level 25 Critter pets.
The Crimson Lupine is a lupine mount that can be purchased for 5,000 from Collector Ta'steld in Oribos during Shadowlands timewalking weeks.
Croc Eggs are clutches of eggs found at the Pit of Scales in Uldum. Upon touching them, Young Crocolisks will spawn and attack the player.
Crimsonbarb Ravagers are ravagers found immediately south of the Pinchwhistle Gearworks in the Spires of Arak.
Crimson Stingers are scorpids found inside the Descent in Tanaan Jungle.
Crimson Windsteed are windsteeds located in the Dawning Valley and at Wu-Song Village on the Wandering Isle.
Crisp Bluff Bock is a drink item sold by the following vendors in Zul'Aman in stacks of 5 for . *Gav'jan *Provisioner Jok *Spicy Min'jaz *Tavikko
Crimsonwood Prowlers are foxes found at the Crimson Forest in Drustvar.
Crimson Lightwood Privacy Screen is housing decor that can be purchased for 150 Brimming Arcana from Neriv at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.

Crimson Tide Treasure is a China-exclusive promotional campaign for World of Warcraft, available through 23 April to 23 May 2026, where players spend Azerothian Treasure Coins to pull a random prize from a pool. Every 10 draws will also provide a "special bonus" reward from a separate, larger pool of rewards. Critter Battler of Outland is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the trainers of Outland with a team of all level 25 Beast pets.
Critter Battler of Cataclysm is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating the trainers of with a team of all level 25 Critter pets.
Crimson Venomfang is a Venomfang achievement reward from Glory of the Venomous Raider.
Crippling Cold is a debuff applied while in Invasion Point: Val. Stacking up to 100, the debuff deals frost damage every 3 seconds. Standing near a brazier will remove the debuff.
Crimson Protectors are stoneborn that spawn at the Royal Cellars in Castle Nathria during A Reflection of Truth.

Cross-realm is a technology that allows other systems to connect to other realms, allowing players to fight each other or join together from other realms. *Cross-realm Battlegrounds was implemented in patch 1.12.0 which decreased waiting times to jump into another battleground by allowing players to fight against other players on another realm in the same battlegroup. *Cross-realm Dungeon Finder was implemented in patch 3.3.0 which allowed players across all realms in a battlegroup to be part of the same queue for Dungeon Finder, further decreasing wait times. *Cross-realm zones was implemented in patch 5.0.4 which puts players from multiple realms into the same "instance" of a particular zo
